compos.text: Alt text: "A smartphone UI displaying a human body with various body systems listed on the right side. The systems include Brain, Eyes, Ears & Hearing, Immune System, Muscles, Lungs & Breathing, Heart & Circulatory, Stomach, Fingers & Toes, and Skin. The 'Fingers & Toes' section is highlighted in green. Each system is represented by an icon next to its label."

Alt text: "Smartphone status bar showing various icons from left to right: Facebook icon, eye icon, airplane mode icon, lock icon, tools icon, shopping bag icon, calendar icon, Bluetooth icon, Wi-Fi icon, battery icon, and the time 6:16."
The image shows the text "Body Scanner" on a dark background.
Alt text: "Breathe2Relax" text displayed on a smartphone UI.

compos.summarization:
The smartphone UI screen is from an app called "Breathe2Relax" and features a "Body Scanner" section. The main content of this screen includes a human body diagram with various body parts highlighted. On the right side, there is a vertical menu with icons representing different body systems or parts, such as:

- Brain
- Eyes
- Ears & Hearing
- Immune System
- Muscles
- Lungs & Breathing
- Heart & Circulatory
- Stomach
- Fingers & Toes
- Skin

Each icon likely corresponds to a specific function or information related to that body part or system. The highlighted section in the diagram and the text "Fingers & Toes" suggest that this part is currently selected.
